questions.question: Can you introduce yourself?
questions.answer: I’m Praveen BG, a product designer with 9+ years of professional experience across Matrimony.com, IDP Education, Gain Credit, and Media.net. My work spans UX strategy, human behaviour, digital products, and AI-enabled experiences.

questions.question: Which domains have you worked in?
questions.answer: My portfolio documents work across AdTech, browser products, FinTech lending, EdTech, international education, and consumer platforms.

questions.question: What did you do at Media.net?
questions.answer: As Senior UX Designer, I worked on Atom Suite browser extensions, improving installation and onboarding journeys through A/B testing, funnel analysis, and UX optimisation across Chrome and Firefox.

questions.question: What did you do at Gain Credit?
questions.answer: As Product Designer at Gain Credit, I simplified compliant financial workflows and improved onboarding clarity and trust for Drafty, a UK line-of-credit product.

questions.question: What did you do at IDP Education?
questions.answer: As UX Designer at IDP Education, I led end-to-end UX from research through delivery for Student Essential Services, integrating accommodation, banking, and loan discovery.

questions.question: What did you do at Matrimony.com?
questions.answer: As Web Designer at Matrimony.com, I designed UI for Bharat Matrimony across web and mobile, improved user journeys with product teams, and created digital marketing assets.

questions.question: What are your core skills?
questions.answer: My documented skills include UX strategy, product thinking, persuasive UX, information architecture, research, journey mapping, usability testing, A/B testing, funnel analysis, interaction design, UI design, and prototyping.

questions.question: Which tools do you use?
questions.answer: My portfolio lists Figma, Sketch, Adobe XD, ChatGPT, Claude, Codex, Lovable, Snitch, GitHub, and Vercel.

questions.question: Show me your work.
questions.answer: My selected work includes Ration Seva, GoNEX, and BitBox. Each is presented as an independent concept with a short case study.

questions.question: Tell me about Ration Seva.
questions.answer: Ration Seva is my service-design concept exploring more convenient and transparent access to public distribution services through doorstep ordering, scheduling, and tracking.

questions.question: Tell me about GoNEX.
questions.answer: GoNEX is my IIM Tiruchirappalli capstone concept for searching, comparing, and booking everyday services through one conversational interface. It is a product concept, not a live provider integration.

questions.question: Tell me about BitBox.
questions.answer: BitBox is my portable-storage product concept with a built-in display for previewing, organising, and managing files without connecting a laptop or phone for quick checks.

questions.question: What have you built with AI?
questions.answer: My AI Lab documents Milan Connect, AI Orchestra, Monster Kids, and Windows AI Companion, with clear labels distinguishing built concepts, system stories, and early experiments.

questions.question: What are Milan Connect and AI Orchestra?
questions.answer: Milan Connect is my AI-assisted missing-child response concept where consequential verification remains human. AI Orchestra is its orchestration story, showing coordinated agents, a visible human review gate, and action.

questions.question: What is your education?
questions.answer: I hold a Master of Computer Applications from VELS University (2014–2016) and a Bachelor of Computer Applications from VELS University (2012–2014).

questions.question: What did you study at IIT Delhi?
questions.answer: I completed an Advanced Certification Programme in Persuasive UX Strategy from IIT Delhi.

questions.question: What was your IIM Tiruchirappalli capstone?
questions.answer: I studied Product Management in the Agentic AI Era at IIM Tiruchirappalli, with GoNEX presented as my associated capstone concept.

questions.question: What is your notice period?
questions.answer: I’m available to join immediately.

questions.question: What are your preferred work locations?
questions.answer: My preferred work locations are Chennai, Bengaluru, and Hyderabad.
